'''Mudflow δ''' is a [[Common enemy]] in ''[[Arknights: Endfield]]''.

{{Enemy description|The "Tholeroygran Dinedon" (archive ID: ACM311δ) is an energized variant of ACM311. It utilizes unique energy pathways and thus maintains a homeostatic temperature significantly below the freezing points of its constituent matter.}}

==Overview==
A unique variant of [[Mudflow]], Mudflows δ have similar appearance with their counterpart, but it doesn't make them more of the threat; Besides capable of dashing and ram, which deals Cryo damage and {{G|Cryo Infliction}}, they can flatten themselves, dealing Cryo damage and {{G|Cryo Infliction}} to Operators around.
